crafted._comment: number of items crafted in the crafting table (every result type counts); medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/crafted/'

differentCards._comment: number of total different card owned in collection

miningEachBlock._comment: number of this amount of blocks mined. 1 set of trophy for each 5 types of block

minepickTotalPicks._comment: number of total picks from minepick, whatever the rarity: medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/minepickTotalPicks/'

minepickSpecificPicks._comment: number of picks OF A CARD of each rarity (1 = common … 5 = mythic): one set of trophies per rarity, medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/minepickSpecificPicks/<rarity>/'

quest._comment: number of Illager quests completed (claimed); medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/quest/'

dailyconnect._comment: number of days connected (daily reward claims); medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/dailyconnect/'

cardsold._comment: number of cards sold to the shop; medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/cardsold/'

trades._comment: player completed trade count; medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/trades/'

friendscount._comment: highest number of distinct friends ever followed (a record: unfollowing never lowers it); medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/friendscount/'

bestfriend._comment: highest friendship XP earned with one friend; the same tiers drive the friendship stars (see FriendshipManager)

likesreceived._comment: number of likes received; medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/likesreceived/'

likessent._comment: number of likes sent; medals in 'assets/img/trophy/Global/likessent/'
